knowledge_graph.title: Doctors of Physical Therapy (formerly Colletti PT)
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "At Doctors of Physical Therapy, we provide evidence-based, compassionate care to our Antioch community. Every patient receives individualized, one-on-one treatment with an expert clinician. We evaluate your condition with a whole body approach, listening to your goals and concerns. Direct Access means you choose where you go for physical therapy. Choose the experts! At DPT, work with you and your physician of choice to develop a plan of care to help you get better, faster."
